article_title: Amy Dowden says Strictly Come Dancing partner Carlos Gu convinced her not to quit dancing

tasks.prompt: What is the main point of Amy Dowden's story?
options: She decided to leave television to become a doctor
Carlos Gu and her husband helped her continue dancing after illness left her at a very low point
She won a new dance competition without any help
She stopped speaking to the other Strictly dancers
tasks.correct_answer: Carlos Gu and her husband helped her continue dancing after illness left her at a very low point
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בכך שקרלוס גו ובעלה בן עודדו את איימי להמשיך לרקוד כשהייתה בנקודת שפל.

tasks.prompt: Who did Dowden credit with persuading her not to hang up her dancing shoes?

The Strictly judges and audience

tasks.explanation_hebrew: איימי זקפה את ההחלטה להמשיך לזכות קרלוס גו ובעלה בן, שנתנו לה תמיכה ומוטיבציה.

tasks.prompt: Why had Dowden been forced to step away from Strictly?

She wanted to train for a different sport

options: They criticised her dancing in public

tasks.explanation_hebrew: tough love כאן פירושו תמיכה תקיפה: הם עודדו אותה ולא אפשרו לה לוותר מתוך תחושת השפל.

tasks.prompt: Why was returning to dancing emotionally important to Dowden? Answer in 2–3 sentences.

expected_points: Dancing was an important part of her identity and professional life

expected_points: She was diagnosed with stage-three breast cancer in 2023
